rules.paraphrase: Time must be billed in tenth-hour increments, per task, exact or rounded down; other increments are returned.
Block billing, grouping several activities under one time charge, is not accepted and invoices containing it are returned.
Incomplete or vague descriptions are unacceptable; the narrative must show why the task was necessary.
No payment for more than ten hours of time by one timekeeper in one day without prior consent.
Monthly invoices within thirty days of period end; no payment for services incurred more than 90 days before submission.
Minimum invoice content: unique number, date, matter ids, dates, timekeeper and level, narrative, rate and total, one matter per invoice.
Duplicate invoice numbers and exact duplicates of a previous invoice are returned.
Rate schedule is approved before billing, one attorney attends events, and support staff and clerks are not billable.
Basic research, clerical tasks, routine internal conferences and budget preparation are not billable.
Meals up to 70 dollars a day on overnight travel, mileage only for 30 miles or more each way, coach air fare, driving time at half rate.
Copies at the lesser of the firm's best rate or eight cents black-and-white and fifty cents colour; scanning up to eight cents.
Overhead items such as research databases, telephone, fax, rent and equipment are never paid.

unmapped_provisions.paraphrase: Vendor costs above 2,000 dollars need prior approval of the Designated Attorney.
Invoices must be submitted through CounselLink in LEDES format.
